question.text: Exit load schedule under SEBI PM Regs (within first 3 years) CAP is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Exit loads capped at 3/2/1% in years 1/2/3; from Year 4 onwards, no exit load permitted. The Trap: Higher exit loads are not permitted. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A Topic 10. Manager's Pro-Tip: Clearly disclose exit loads in the DD and MITC — surprise exit charges are a common dispute topic.
